🌟 Nurturing the Next Generation of Leaders!
I’m happy to support and participate in NAVDRISHTI 2026 – The Grand CA Students Mega Conference, organised by the Board of Studies – Operations, ICAI, and hosted by ICAI Patna Branch & CICASA Patna.
📅 3rd & 4th October 2026
📍 URJA Auditorium, Patna, Bihar
⏰ 9:00 AM onwards
👥 Expected: 1000+ CA Student Delegates
💰 Registration Fee: Only ₹500
This conference is a great platform for CA students to learn, network, exchange ideas and gain valuable professional exposure.
👉 Register using my Referral Code: GOLU-5207
📲 Scan the QR code in the poster to register.
I encourage all CA students to join us and be a part of this exciting event! Let's make 
hashtag
#NAVDRISHTI2026 a memorable experience for the CA student community. 🚀
See you at Patna! 🤝
